smoothing.s_r: sum of target_entry_v1 in the fitting rows for region r
smoothing.n_r: number of fitting rows for region r
smoothing.mu: mean target_entry_v1 in the fitting rows

training_encoding.leakage_rule: the encoded value for a training row is computed only from rows outside that row's fold
training_encoding.post_oof_fit: after OOF values are produced, the encoder is fitted on the complete training partition for forward transforms

missing_geography.conversion: missing addr_id is converted to the literal group __MISSING__
missing_geography.treatment: a smoothed region group when observed in fitting rows; otherwise the relevant global fallback

population_rules.rule: population filtering precedes partitioning and encoder fitting

split_and_shift_rules.primary: fit on the population-specific frozen primary training partition; transform its validation and test partitions
split_and_shift_rules.matched_random: refit from the matched-random training partition only
split_and_shift_rules.matched_spatial: refit from the matched-spatial training partition only; validation/test addr_id values absent from training use the training global mean
